name: repo-commit-latest
summary:
Repo commit observed: 4026de81a2d8 — project-memory: add production readiness diagnostics runner

Add a read-only Project Memory production readiness diagnostics runner.

The runner executes the existing readiness path:
- ProjectMemoryRuntimeCheck
- ProjectMemoryLiveDbCheck
- ProjectMemoryProductionReadinessCheck

The runner is evidence-gated and returns not-ready unless all required runtime/deploy/DB behavior evidence is present.

No production readiness claim is made by this change.
